nom: APRILSKIN Calendula Flower-Infused Facial Peel Off Mask

segments.sensitive: The reviewers who address sensitive skin, including one who used it with her tween daughter and a licensed esthetician, describe it as gentle and non-irritating, though it is noted as not being a strong treatment for clearing out pores.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers mention a brighter, more youthful-looking glow after a few days of use, including one esthetician who calls it resurfacing and youth-boosting, but this is based on very few mentions.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report softer, smoother, or more hydrated skin afterward, including one who calls her skin 'plump' after a single use during a dry season; one reviewer, however, used it for several weeks and did not notice her skin becoming softer or more supple.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports it reduced dry, red patches on her skin and left it glowy; a different reviewer, from what she believes was a different batch, says the product's strong chemical smell made her eyes turn red.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers, including one who used it with her sensitive-skinned daughter, report no irritation from the mask; one reviewer, however, says it broke her out despite the product being marketed for sensitive skin.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report clearer skin, fewer clogged pores, or reduced breakouts, including one who saw a brief breakout in the first day or two before her skin improved; one reviewer, however, says it broke out her nose.

aspects.libelle: Dark flecks look alarming but are dried calendula petals
Half-filled tube or large air bubble on arrival
Small tube; a thick layer is needed each use
Satisfying, easy peel-off with minimal flaking
Good value for a quality product
Strong glue-like smell for some batches

extraits.titre: broke out my face, expensive, normal face mask
extraits.texte: it’s just like any other kind of facial it broke out my nose, even though it says for sensitive skin it has brown little particles. I don’t know if that’s part of it but there’s just brown stuff floating around. It looks like dirt and stuff. it’s not a good product

I’ve been obsessing over k-beauty wrapping masks. I’ve tried a medicube one and a medipeel one. Loved both. So I decided to try this one. It has great for your skin ingredients like calendula, niacinimide, BHA and PHA. It is best for oily skin, clogged pores, blackheads/whiteheads, sebaceous filaments. I don’t have major issues with any of that. After peeling it off, I didn’t see much of a glow and my face felt tight. It was a disappointment because I automatically compared it to the other wrapping masks I’d tried. But clearly I’m not the demographic for this product. I should’ve read carefully.

Korean skincare has been touted as the 'best' so I was eager to check out this face peel. I chose it after seeing a YouTuber brag about it. (sorry- can't recall who it was now.) I used a silicone applicator brush to apply it to my face and neck (see my review of it- HIGHLY recommend that product). It has a watery hair gel consistency so I didn't want to apply with my hands. The product goes on easily with an applicator and dries fairly quickly. Once dry, it also peels off easily without any flaking (YAY!) and does not rip your skin as you remove it (which I have had happen with other brands.) Overall, my skin felt cleaner afterwards, but I wouldn't say it felt softer or more supple having used it. (bummer- that's why I bought it!) I used it on a weekly basis for several weeks but didn't notice any difference in my skin's appearance. The container isn't very big either (It's smaller than a normal sized tube of toothpaste) so I would say you will be lucky to stretch it out to 6 weeks if you use it weekly on your face and neck. You want to make sure to apply it thick enough so you can easily peel it off when dry. This product is 'okay' but I am going to continue searching for something better since I don't feel this made much of a difference to my skin.

extraits.titre: Great for tweens and people with sensitive skin, not super strong
extraits.texte: First, as some other reviewers mentioned, the tube is only filled half way and there is no safety seal. That being said, it smells very nice, and it is easy to apply and peel off. My daughter and I used this tonight and we liked it, it made our skin very smooth. But do not expect this to pull all the impurities out of your pores, it’s not that strong.

Difficult to peel off so I just let it dry and rinse off. In my opinion it doesnt matter because I saw better skin the next morning(I use ever other evening). Helped reduce dry red patches, minimized pores and left my skin glowy. I ordered the cleanser just now. Very impressed by this high quality yet reasonably priced product.

I was looking for something to help revamp plumpness and hydration in my skin from the dryer fall/winter season. I’ve been struggling most recently with bad breakouts as well. I saw this and thought I’d give it a try. Absolutely FELL IN LOVE after the first use. My skin was sssoooooooo plump and hydrated. I am stunned at how improved my skin is after one use. I feel like I just got a facial. Can’t recommend enough 🤍🤍🤍

extraits.titre: THIS STUFF IS THE REAL DEAL!! WILL BE RE-BUYING FOREVER AND EVER AND EVER AND EVER
extraits.texte: This mask has it ALL!!! Not only does it balance out your skin tone, moisturize and nourish the skin, minimize pores and wrinkles, brightens the skin, BUT IT ALSO CLEARS OUT BLACK-/WHITEHEADS???? it's literally all my skin products and masks put into one bottle T-T <3 It's a dream come true; a face mask that is truly a one-hit wonder <3 <3 <3 <3 Although it might be worth mentioning that this stuff as a detoxifier is hardcore; the first day after using it, my face started to break out a bit, but only because it *continues* to bring out the toxins in your face. By day 2, my face was clearing up and looking pretty. And by day 3??? i literally looked 2yrs younger (i even got some compliments)!! As i've continued using the face mask over the past month or so since purchasing it, this remains consistent; your face looks better and better as the days pass, resulting to the skin becoming smooth and glossy like a k-pop star (just like the advertisement said it would) after a couple days!! Also worth mentioning that the mask is sticky and thick. Like with most masks, i used my face mask applicator tool thingy, but found that to be rather frustrating with this stuff :/ So now i instead simply wash my hands first, then apply the mask with my fingers; makes it a lot easier. Also, i found that even if i think i applied it on a bit too thick, it still dries the same so that's cool ^-^ You should definitely buy this! You won't regret it!
